verdict.rationale: Marketing pages mention 'automatic registration completion in 13 jurisdictions' and a UK registration threshold tracker, implying Anrok handles state/local registrations on the customer's behalf, but there's no documentation of per-registration pricing transparency or a dedicated status-tracking UI for registrations. missing for 10: explicit per-registration pricing details, a documented registration status/tracking workflow, and independent confirmation the vendor actually files registrations rather than just alerting/tracking thresholds.
